pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Verse 1]
In this room, quietly sinking down,
Only your warmth still lingers here.
The words we used to promise tomorrow,
They still seep in, painfully clear.
Walking through the memories we left behind,
My frozen heart begins to sway.
On the day I lost your love,
Cold tears fall again today.

[Pre-Chorus]
No matter how hard I try to erase it,
Your name keeps pulling me back.
No matter how far I try to run,
I always find my way to you again.

[Chorus]
The scars of love hurt way too much,
Bruising deep inside my chest.
Through the cracks of my broken heart,
The sorrow you left spreads endlessly.
If I could smile just one more time,
I try to forget, but I can’t.
Gathering the shattered pieces of me,
I end up crying again.
Can I ever love again?

[Verse 2]
Inside the echo of your vanished voice,
I’m still standing where you left me.
The moments I tried to hold onto
Stay like thorns buried deep in me.
The more I try to erase them, the clearer they grow,
Nights where tomorrow feels so frightening.
The words I never got to say
Scatter in the air and cry.

[Pre-Chorus]
Will I ever love someone again?
Can I escape from your shadow?
I’m afraid this unhealed wound
Will break me all over again.

[Chorus]
The scars of love hurt way too much,
I’m scared to love again.
My heart is still living inside of you,
Only painful memories hold me tight.
If I could smile just one more time,
Could I live without you somehow?
Holding onto my scattered heart,
I quietly cry again.
Can I ever love again?

[Bridge]
Standing on what’s left of my heart,
Staring at the ruins of our love.
Even when I tell myself to let you go,
Why does it hurt this much?
With this chest about to burst,
Can I really love again?

[Final Chorus]
The scars of love hurt way too much,
I’m afraid love might come again.
My trembling heart is screaming out,
“Just one more time… please, just once more…”
At the end of this night, blurred with tears,
I whisper softly to myself,
Someday, will I be able to love?
Will I truly be able to love again…
“Can I love again…”
pkg.sunoStyle:
Trendy pop with a soft, energetic groove. Modern, fresh and emotional.
Male-female duet vocals throughout. Alternating lines, natural vocal interplay, gentle harmonies, clear and expressive vocals. Keep both voices distinct and balanced.
Light and simple intro with soft harmony. Verses begin gently with light rhythm, subtle percussion and restrained bass. Pre-chorus gradually builds emotional tension through delicate textures and rhythmic movement, without sudden intensity.
Chorus adds warmth and energy with warm bass, gentle harmonies and a smooth rhythmic lift. Emotional and engaging, but controlled and never explosive.
Final section gradually reduces energy, returning to soft duet vocals and minimal accompaniment, ending calm and reflective.
Natural dynamics, warm tone, clean modern production. Avoid loud mastering, heavy bass, excessive drums, dense layers and aggressive instrumentation.
